reason: The sheet books every target sale exactly at the target. When the day OPENS above the target, a resting limit sell fills at the open: a sale at the lower target price is impossible on that bar's first trade, so the honest fill is max(target, open).

The sheet books the breakout buy at the previous 20-day high even when the day opened above it. A buy stop cannot fill below the open (that price never traded after the trigger), so the honest fill is max(level, open).

Same buy-stop rule; the dashboard's SST 2.0 already books max(level, open), so nothing changes here. Listed because the fill is not at the level: a fill at the level is impossible when the open is above it.

The sheet buys at (high + low) / 2 of the signal day. That mid-point is not a tradable price: it is only known after the close and may never have traded. The honest preset buys at the close of the signal day.

The sheet needs High strictly above the target. A limit sell resting at the target fills when the price touches it; requiring a higher print is impossible to enforce on an exchange, so High >= target fills.
